overview: Spiritual Connect is a comprehensive devotional platform for Hindu, Jain, and Sikh traditions. It features Aarti, Chalisa, Mantra, and Stotra libraries, a temple directory, puja booking, a Chadhava/Bhet section for sacred offerings, and a spiritual shop.
features: Aarti, Chalisa, Mantra, and Stotra libraries with 200+ entries
Chadhava/Bhet page with 40+ temple offering cards grouped by date and occasion
Spiritual shop with 18 product categories (Rudraksha, Gemstones, Yantras, etc.)
Searchable temple directory with 50+ Hindu/Jain/Sikh temples
Puja booking with Sankalp, date picker, and confirmation
Admin CMS for managing all content
Saffron/gold spiritual theme with Hindi and English support
